comment: The configuration keys the api, worker and mcp-server binaries accept (crates/platform/src/config/raw.rs; every section denies unknown keys). Read by scripts/start.sh --check-config. The platform test config::schema_tests compares this file with the Rust types and fails when either side gains or loses a key.

retired.mcp.auth_token: the shared inbound secret has been removed and the MCP server refuses to start while the key is present. An http/sse caller now presents its own workspace bot token in the Authorization: Bearer opr_... header, which the server forwards to the API unchanged. Fix: delete the auth_token line from the [mcp] section
